description: OSINT platforms and tools catalogued in the OSINT Maritime Framework paper (Nasr et al., IEEE Access 2026, DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3673557). Six categories covering vessel tracking, regulatory intelligence, personnel, geospatial, digital infrastructure, and analytical tools. This replaces the generic OSINT catalog with the framework's own tool inventory.

framework.title: A Proactive Defense: An Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) Framework for Maritime Cybersecurity

notes: All platforms are publicly accessible; no data-sharing agreement required.
This catalog is the framework paper's own tool inventory (Tables 1-6), replacing any generic OSINT source list.

The implementation paper (Access-2026-38078) operationalizes a subset of these tools: Equasis (via equasis-cli), Shodan, MarineTraffic, VesselFinder, MyShipTracking, OpenSanctions, OCCRP, Firecrawl/Bing, MISP — see paper-sources.json for the validation source set.
